create.title: Create an event
create.approvalNote: You approve join requests; nobody joins until you do.
create.fixErrors: Fix the marked fields to continue.

fields.title: Title
fields.addressHint: Only you and the players you approve can see it.
fields.locationApprovedHint: Until approved, people only see the district.
fields.autoApprove: Approve requests automatically while a spot is free
fields.autoApproveHint: Players are approved at once while a spot is free and nobody is waiting. Otherwise you decide on each request.
fields.bookingHint: Declared by the organizer; the app does not make bookings.
fields.costHint: For information only; no payment is taken in the app.
fields.participantNotesHint: Only players you approve can see it (e.g. meeting point).
fields.immutableHint: After publishing, sport, format and whether you play cannot change.
fields.venueHint: Unverified venues were suggested by players. The booking status is always what the organizer declares.

detail.notFound: This event doesn't exist or you can't view it.
detail.whereHidden: {{district}} · exact place shown to approved players
detail.confirmDelete: The draft will be deleted permanently. Are you sure?
detail.participantsHidden: The list of players is shown to approved players.

edit.title: Edit event
edit.materialHint: If you change the time or place of a live event, participants are notified.

cancel.title: Cancel event
cancel.body: A canceled event cannot be restored. Everyone with a request or a spot is notified; there is no negative effect for participants.

discover.emptyBody: Be the first to organize one.
discover.noMatchBody: Try a different day or clear a filter.

card.placeHidden: {{district}} · exact place shown to approved players

discover.pickerTitle: Which court are we playing on?
discover.pickerHint: Pick a sport to see open events. You can change it later from above the list.
discover.noSportBody: Try another sport or see all of them.

join.signInToJoin: Sign in to request a spot

stateHint.REQUESTED: We'll tell you when the organizer decides.
stateHint.WAITLISTED: If a spot opens the organizer decides; we'll tell you.
stateHint.APPROVED: The exact place is shown on this page. If you can't make it, let the organizer know early.

join.limitReached: You've used all your requests for this event.
join.disclosure: The organizer will see your display name, level, rating and reliability.
join.autoApproveNote: If a spot is free, your request is approved right away.
join.approvalNote: Your spot is not confirmed until the organizer approves.
join.waitlistNote: The event is full. If a spot opens, the organizer decides.

requests.title: Requests
requests.fullHint: The event is full: a spot must open before you can approve.
requests.confirmRemove: Remove {{name}} from the event? This can't be undone.
requests.confirmReject: Decline {{name}}? This is final for this event.

UPCOMING.title: You haven't joined any events yet
UPCOMING.body: Upcoming events with a confirmed spot are listed here.

APPLIED.title: No open requests
APPLIED.body: Events you asked to join and waitlists appear here.

ORGANIZING.title: You aren't organizing any events
ORGANIZING.body: Your drafts and upcoming events appear here.

PAST.title: No past events
PAST.body: Finished, canceled and completed events stay here.

validation.TITLE_TOO_SHORT: The title needs at least 3 characters.
validation.TITLE_TOO_LONG: The title can have at most 80 characters.
validation.DESCRIPTION_TOO_LONG: The description can have at most 2000 characters.
validation.START_IN_PAST: The start can't be in the past.
validation.START_TOO_SOON: To publish, the event must start at least 1 hour from now.
validation.START_TOO_FAR: Events can be planned at most a year ahead.
validation.DURATION_INVALID: Duration must be between 15 minutes and 8 hours.
validation.DISTRICT_REQUIRED: Choose a city and a district.
validation.PLACE_TOO_SHORT: The place needs at least 3 characters.
validation.PLACE_TOO_LONG: The place can have at most 120 characters.
validation.ADDRESS_TOO_LONG: The address can have at most 300 characters.
validation.NOTES_TOO_LONG: The note can have at most 1000 characters.
validation.CAPACITY_OUT_OF_RANGE: Capacity must be within this format's limits.
validation.SKILL_RANGE_INVALID: The lowest level can't be above the highest.
validation.COST_INVALID: Enter the cost as a number (e.g. 150 or 150,50).
validation.COST_NOTE_TOO_LONG: The cost note can have at most 200 characters.
validation.EQUIPMENT_TOO_LONG: The equipment note can have at most 500 characters.
validation.CANCEL_MESSAGE_TOO_LONG: The message can have at most 500 characters.

invite.title: Invite link
invite.body: This event is visible by invitation only. Anyone who has the link can see the event and ask to join, so share it only with the people you choose.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.confirm: You cannot change the marks after finalizing. Continue?
attendance.confirmUnmarked_one: {{count}} player is not marked: this counts neither for nor against them. You cannot change the marks after finalizing. Continue?
attendance.confirmUnmarked_other: {{count}} players are not marked: this counts neither for nor against them. You cannot change the marks after finalizing. Continue?
attendance.finalized: Attendance is final. For 72 hours players can leave reviews and dispute an absent mark.
attendance.waiting: The organizer has not finalized attendance yet.

mine.NOT_CONFIRMED: The organizer did not mark you. This counts neither for nor against you.
mine.DISPUTED: Your dispute is under review. Until it is resolved, this event does not affect your reliability.

attendance.disputeHint: Read by administrators. At most 500 characters.
attendance.absentClosed: You were marked absent. The time to dispute has passed.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.blind: Review the people you played with. Nobody can see your score; players only see the overall result when the time is up.
reviews.final: You cannot change a review after sending it. You can review the others later.

body.REQUESTED: We'll tell you when the organizer approves.
body.WAITLISTED: If a spot opens, the organizer decides; we'll tell you.
body.APPROVED: The exact place is on the event page. If you can't make it, let the organizer know early.
